summary.recommendation: Do not generalize by expanding the RouteSignal playbook. Add a product-agnostic universal sales knowledge module, vertical adapter skeletons, and a campaign playbook adapter before migrating RouteSignal.
summary.core_finding: The semantic frame and state/action contracts are reusable, but contextual_buyer_semantics.py currently imports the RouteSignal diagnostic playbook directly, so universal semantics are coupled to one campaign.

inbound demo follow-up and workflow-review copy
LIVE_DEMO_014 and DIALOGUE_MANAGER_003 product checkpoint expectations
mixed_pieces: CORE_DIAGNOSTIC_GAPS currently comes from the RouteSignal playbook
universal semantic helpers can emit RouteSignal/Northstar/demo-follow-up wording
dialogue_manager.py is mostly universal but workflow-review target wording is campaign-shaped
validators 001 through 009 test universal behaviors with RouteSignal gap IDs

recommended_phases.name: universal sales knowledge module
recommended_phases.goal: Create product-agnostic primitives and a validator proving no campaign facts are embedded.

recommended_phases.name: vertical adapter skeletons
recommended_phases.goal: Add compact deterministic vertical defaults and regulated caution boundaries.

recommended_phases.name: campaign playbook adapter
recommended_phases.goal: Route contextual semantics through an adapted campaign contract instead of direct RouteSignal imports.

recommended_phases.name: cross-vertical smoke tests
recommended_phases.goal: Prove universal workflows stay safe across required verticals without provider calls or real data.

recommended_phases.name: RouteSignal regression after adapter migration
recommended_phases.goal: Preserve current RouteSignal behavior after separating universal, vertical, and campaign layers.

uncertainty_or_blockers: This audit did not run a broad generated-evidence crawl by design.
The exact adapter API should be decided in 4B3 after 4B1 and 4B2 define stable universal and vertical contracts.
Some RouteSignal wording may also exist in older generated reports or checkpoint docs outside the targeted scope, but those are historical unless referenced by active runtime or validators.
